source.title: Increased connectivity of hiPSC-derived neural networks in multiphase granular hydrogel scaffolds

material: Bulk HyStem thiolated HA / PEGDA hydrogel, 2.0 w/v %

formulation.evidence: various concen­trations of HyStem® precursors (0.5, 1.0, 1.5, or 2.0 w/v %) were reconstituted with corresponding amounts of degassed water

youngs_modulus.evidence: The highest G′ value was measured for the most concentrated hydrogel formulation (324 ± 93 Pa for 2.0 w/v %)

notes: Measured by diffusing wave spectroscopy microrheology at 37 °C; G' at 100 Hz equivalent for bulk gels. Shortest gelation time (~2 min).
